firmware.releaseNotes: Restore the original AT32F435RGT7_SDIO dialplate UI code: original fonts, layout, placeholders, clipping, heading arrow and animations. Preserve existing foreground/modal safeguards and use a small spectrum transfer buffer for the F435 memory budget without changing rendered pixels. UI-only migration; HAL, OTA companion/file management, recorder admission, navigation, factory UID and App 1.0.95+121 remain unchanged. Full/recovery candidate only; owner controls publication and installation. No device operation or backend deployment.
